technique_name: Produce a report describing the current state of the economy.
description: The current state of the global economy is one of both strength and uncertainty. While certain industries have seen considerable growth due to advances in technology and globalization, others are still burdened by the effects of the 2008 recession. In the United States, overall economic growth has been steady in recent years, although the unemployment rate remains above historic averages.
